name: parthnagarkar875/Sclera_Recognition
description: A new method for bio metric authentication system was developed in which the users were authenticated on the basis of their Sclera. A photo of the user's eye was captured and it was processed with the help of filters and different algorithms to extract the features, namely Blood vessels visible on the user's Sclera. These features were stored in the database and were compared with the new features that were generated every time a user tried to authenticate herself.
